packet.description_seed: Local media say 21 people were saved after the boat overturned in rough seas near an island in south Vietnam.

The boat was carrying 36 people when it overturned around 400 metres (440 yards) off May Rut Ngoai islet, according to the VNExpress website. Multiple tourist and coast guard boats participated in a rescue effort during which some people were plucked safely from the water. Stay up to date with the latest news. Follow KT on WhatsApp Channels. Nguyen Tien Hai, a provincial official of the ruling Communist Party, said authorities were still confirming the exact number of survivors, according to the state media report. Hai said initial assessments suggested that the speedboat may have overturned due to heavy winds and high waves.

Several tourist vessels operating in the area quickly came to the rescue, finding many passengers trapped inside the speedboat, Vietnam's VnExpress reported. Twenty one people were later saved. original_article.research:
[Lähde: BBC World]
Ambulances line up on a pier to help victims after a tourist vessel capsized off Phu Quoc island in southern Vietnam

Fifteen people have died after a speedboat carrying Indian tourists capsized near a island in the south of Vietnam, according to local media reports.

Local authorities say 32 Indians and four crew were on board the vessel, which overturned about 400 metres (1,312 ft) from Hon May Rut Ngoai island in rough sea conditions on Saturday.

Several tourist vessels operating in the area quickly came to the rescue, finding many passengers trapped inside the speedboat, Vietnam's VnExpress reported. Twenty one people were later saved.

Hon May Rut Ngoai - a pristine island in the An Thoi Archipelago in the Gulf of Thailand - attracts many tourists from around the world for island-hopping boat tours.

Video from the scene shows the capsized boat

Hon May Rut Ngoai is located about 10km (six miles) south of Phu Quoc, Vietnam's largest island.

Nguyen Tien Hai, a senior Communist official in the area, said the authorities were still working to confirm the exact number of those who died as well as the survivors.

He is quoted by VnExpress as saying that the speedboat may have capsized due to heavy winds and high waves.

"The top priority is rescue, bringing all victims ashore and focusing all efforts on providing emergency care to those who are still alive," Hai said.

The Indian embassy in Vietnam described the incident as "tragic", publishing the full list of the 32 Indian nationals who were on board the capsized boat.

The embassy also set up the telephone hotlines to "provide information and assistance to affected families".

---

[Lähde: Khaleej Times]
A speedboat carrying Indian tourists capsized off southern Vietnam's Phu Quoc island on Saturday, killing at least 15 people, state media reported.

The boat was carrying 36 people when it overturned around 400 metres (440 yards) off May Rut Ngoai islet, according to the VNExpress website.

Multiple tourist and coast guard boats participated in a rescue effort during which some people were plucked safely from the water.

Stay up to date with the latest news. Follow KT on WhatsApp Channels.

Nguyen Tien Hai, a provincial official of the ruling Communist Party, said authorities were still confirming the exact number of survivors, according to the state media report.

Hai said initial assessments suggested that the speedboat may have overturned due to heavy winds and high waves.

Located just south of Vietnam's largest island Phu Quoc, May Rut Ngoai is known for its pristine blue waters, white sand beaches and accessible diving reefs.

Visitors often access the islet by speedboat from the main island.

Phu Quoc has seen a major tourism boom in recent years, with more than 1.8 million foreigners visiting the island last year.

[Lähde: The Avenue Mail]
Hanoi: A speedboat carrying Indian tourists capsized near Vietnam’s Phu Quoc Island on Saturday, killing 15 people and injuring 21 others.

Local media reports confirm that rescuers rushed 21 survivors to nearby medical facilities for emergency treatment following the accident.

While local authorities continue their search and rescue operations, the exact cause of the tragedy remains unknown, according to the Indian Embassy in Vietnam.

“In a tragic incident, a boat carrying several Indian tourists has capsized near Phu Quoc Island in Vietnam a few hours ago,” the Embassy of India in Hanoi posted on X. “Exact details of the incident are being ascertained as search and rescue operations by local authorities are ongoing.”

To assist affected families, the Consulate General of India in Ho Chi Minh City and the embassy in Hanoi have established dedicated emergency control rooms.

Technical Malfunction Behind the Tragedy

Vietnamese news outlet VnExpress reported that the Ocean Pear Island Company speedboat was carrying 32 Indian tourists, a flight attendant, and four crew members when it capsized near Hon May Rut Ngoai island.

According to officials from the Phu Quoc Special Economic Zone, the vessel suffered an unexpected technical malfunction and overturned around 1 PM.

Nearby tourist boats immediately rushed to the scene to rescue survivors. The An Thoi Port Border Guard Station confirmed the fatalities include 13 men and two women.

The Guard station deployed two vessels and 35 officers to coordinate ongoing search efforts with the Vietnamese Navy and Coast Guard.

May Rut Ngoai Island is a highly popular destination for coral reef diving, drawing visitors who typically take a 20-to-40-minute speedboat ride to reach the location.

payload.title: Turistivene kaatui Vietnamissa – 15 ihmistä kuoli
payload.summary: Intialaisia matkailijoita kuljettanut pikavene kaatui lauantaina Phu Quocin saaren lähellä Etelä-Vietnamissa. Paikallismedian mukaan 15 ihmistä kuoli ja 21 pelastettiin.
payload.content:
Intialaisia matkailijoita kuljettanut pikavene kaatui lauantaina Etelä-Vietnamissa lähellä Phu Quocin saarta. Paikallismedian mukaan onnettomuudessa kuoli 15 ihmistä ja 21 pelastettiin. Aluksella oli viranomaisten tietojen mukaan yhteensä 36 ihmistä: 32 intialaista matkailijaa ja neljä miehistön jäsentä. Vene oli palaamassa saariretkeltä, kun se kaatui kovassa aallokossa.

Lähistön veneet aloittivat pelastamisen

Onnettomuus tapahtui noin 400 metrin päässä Hon May Rut Ngoain saaresta. Lähistöllä liikkuneet turistiveneet kiiruhtivat ensimmäisinä paikalle ja aloittivat vedessä olleiden ihmisten pelastamisen. Silminnäkijöiden mukaan rajavartiosto, merivoimat, rannikkovartiosto ja muut pelastusviranomaiset liittyivät myöhemmin operaatioon. Pelastustöihin osallistui useita alueella toimineita veneitä. Monet matkustajat olivat jääneet loukkuun kaatuneen pikaveneen sisälle. Korkeat aallot vaikeuttivat pelastustoimia, mutta kaikkiaan 21 ihmistä saatiin turvaan. Paikallismedian mukaan selviytyneet kuljetettiin läheisiin terveydenhuollon yksiköihin kiireellistä hoitoa varten. Ensimmäisissä tiedoissa heidän kerrottiin loukkaantuneen, mutta vammojen vakavuudesta ei annettu tarkempia tietoja.

Onnettomuuden syytä selvitetään

Onnettomuuden tarkkaa syytä ei ollut vahvistettu. Vietnamilaisen puoluevirkamiehen Nguyen Tien Hain välittämän alustavan arvion mukaan pikavene on saattanut kaatua voimakkaan tuulen ja korkeiden aaltojen vuoksi. Intian Vietnamin-suurlähetystö korosti puolestaan, että tapahtuman yksityiskohtien ja turman syyn selvittäminen oli yhä kesken. Paikalliset viranomaiset jatkoivat myös kuolleiden ja pelastettujen täsmällisten lukumäärien varmistamista. Intian Hanoin-suurlähetystö kertoi onnettomuudesta viestipalvelu X:ssä pelastustoimien ollessa vielä käynnissä. Lähetystö ja Intian pääkonsulaatti Ho Chi Minh Cityssä perustivat erilliset hätätilanteen yhteyspisteet. Niiden tarkoituksena on auttaa onnettomuudesta kärsineitä perheitä ja välittää vahvistettuja tietoja viranomaisten selvitystyön edetessä.

Suosittu saariretkien kohde

Hon May Rut Ngoai kuuluu Thaimaanlahdella sijaitsevaan An Thoin saaristoon. Saari on suosittu pysähdyspaikka Phu Quocin ympäristössä järjestettävillä saaristoveneretkillä ja houkuttelee matkailijoita eri puolilta maailmaa. Phu Quoc on Vietnamin suurin saari. Onnettomuuteen joutunut pikavene oli palaamassa saarelta, kun se kaatui lyhyen matkan päässä rannasta.
summary_bullets: Pikaveneessä oli 32 intialaista matkailijaa ja neljä miehistön jäsentä.
Paikallismedian mukaan 15 ihmistä kuoli ja 21 pelastettiin.
Onnettomuuden tarkkaa syytä selvitetään, mutta voimakkaan tuulen ja korkeiden aaltojen epäillään vaikuttaneen turmaan.
payload.journalist_note: Kuolonuhrien ja pelastettujen määrät perustuvat useiden tiedotusvälineiden välittämiin paikallisviranomaisten tietoihin. Onnettomuuden syytä ei ole vahvistettu, joten sääolosuhteiden mahdollinen vaikutus esitetään alustavana arviona.

Local media reports confirm that rescuers rushed 21 survivors to nearby medical facilities for emergency treatment following the accident. While local authorities continue their search and rescue operations, the exact cause of the tragedy remains unknown, according to the Indian Embassy in Vietnam. “In a tragic incident, a boat carrying several Indian tourists has capsized near Phu Quoc Island in Vietnam a few hours ago,” the Embassy of India in Hanoi posted on X. “Exact details of the incident are being ascertained as search and rescue operations by local authorities are ongoing.” To assist affected families, the Consulate General of India in Ho Chi Minh City and the embassy in Hanoi have established dedicated emergency control rooms.
